_comment: scene_ground: target-view recovery in photoreal v2 levels. The agent sees a target screenshot taken from a deterministic per-(level,seed) pose, then walks the level (collision-aware) to match it. PASS = final pose within position+yaw tolerance.
_per_level_notes: spawn_pose = where pawn lands after OpenLevel switch (z-lifted if pawn defaults underground); z_offset_cm = how much to lift pawn after switch; warmup_s = wait after lift before screenshots are usable (GI / lumen settle); target_anchors = hand-picked walkable points captured by manual WASD pilot — target poses are sampled NEAR these anchors (small jitter only) so the random target never lands in a confusing hallway corner / dead-end / wedged behind furniture. forest is excluded — its open-terrain semantic doesn't fit the room-recovery task.
_pass_condition: Final agent pose's XY distance from target_pose <= tolerance_xy_cm AND yaw_delta <= tolerance_yaw_deg AND pitch_delta <= tolerance_pitch_deg. All three axes must match — view recovery is about reproducing the framing, not just standing in the same room.
